body:
**Leaderboard disclosure first:** this packing improves the registry, but **does not beat** the cached per-puzzle side-only entry: 15.596043116646 (square1000, 2026-10-29; cache 2026-11-09 20:52 UTC). Our exact side is 15.6008017348117538…, about 0.004758618166 larger. The side-only entry supplies no packing we can verify, and the cache may be stale.

**Registration request / credit:** Doğa Özden ([@dogaozden](https://github.com/dogaozden), https://dogaozden.com/math/live/square-packing/), found by his AI research lab. Prepared and posted on his behalf by his AI agent. Please record Doğa Özden as found_by for this new arrangement; the old record remains credited to Francisco Couzo and PingYou Ltd, and Evan Daniel is credited for the optimizer.

**Claim:** s(228) ≤ **15.600801734812** (exact rational side rounded UP at 12 places). The exact side, specified in the witness, is 15.6008017348117538028514559173910014808630264… . The registry's current verified bound at main @fa980f8e is 15.60460147572967429 (Couzo, improved PingYou Ltd, 2026-10-13). Exact Fraction comparison gives an improvement of **0.00379974091792048**, relative 2.435e-4. This is feasibility only: no optimality, KKT or rigidity claim.

**Certificate:** https://github.com/kenaznia-doga/s228-upper-bound/tree/8bebf3f78ef50baa0b47341a836b5e45717c49cc
- `n-228-candidate.yaml`: packing.squares:Witness/v2, 228 exact unit squares, rational corners. SHA-256 `4dc2075f5fb06bb7a1ca68aabd8eebd0d326c16c5f408151876a165d2246b747`.
- `n228-witness.json`: same witness as JSON.
- `n-228-decimal-pose.yaml`: source pose, named by source.path; certificate.replay names the repository's candidate.
- `verify-228.txt`: unmodified registry packing-witness verify @fa980f8e: VERIFIED, exact-algebraic over Q, **25,878 pairs**.
- `sqcheck-228.txt`: independently implemented checker: **VALID, exact-rational**, side ≤15.600801734811754. Code and instructions included.

**Conversion/checks:** the raw decimal pose is interval-CERTIFIED at its own side, pair margin ≥2.02e-13 and wall margin ≥1.01e-13. The registry's unmodified promote --strategy robust-rational constructs rational unit frames, center_dilation=1 (no dilation). Translation to minimum corner zero and recomputing maximum extent reduces the search side by 2.04e-13; that is normalization, not the 0.0038 geometric gain. Registry verify tests all pairs (exact minimum best gap 101/500000000000000, minimum wall clearance 0); independent sqcheck tests the exact result. JSON reports retained in checks/. Promotion shares code with registry verify; sqcheck is separate. No proof-assistant or outside human review claimed.

**Method/provenance:** an original AI-run column-band proposal design (Sol near1, gpt-6.1-sol), not a donor/transplant start or public recovery. Axis-parallel squares occupy staircase/corner domains; tilted stacks span a diagonal band. Finite-memory column DP generates proposals; no global count optimality is asserted for arbitrary-angle junctions. Full emitted-count and far-overlap audits precede one Evan Daniel ALM+SLP fq quench (evand/square-packing, search/packer, built from bb4cc78e, MIT). No random kicks were used for this hit. Proposal: f=.596543, delta=1°, tol=.03, count=228, nt=48, ox=.026742, variant=1, corner layout t:4,4. Search decimal side 15.60080173481195764, at 121 seconds; full raw pose and metadata included. Final packing has 50 squares tilted >0.5°, compared with the record's 51. All 228 centres move >.001 vs the record up to square symmetries, 93 >.05 (maximum .940); 59 retilt >1°. Comparison image included.

**Other public values:** best public Kaggle packing found: 15.604601475744 (kirilltym, data fetched 2026-11-11 03:32 UTC), above ours. Open n228 issues #593/#375/#419/#405 and open PR titles checked at fa980f8e on 2026-11-14; no lower competing n228 packing found. evand/square-packing HEAD still c801ab47. This is not a claim of beating the side-only leaderboard.

**License / AI:** CC BY 4.0 for witness/data/text, MIT for code; Evan Daniel's MIT notice included. Search, checks and filing were AI-assisted throughout. Reproduction commands and exact rational in README/witness.
title: s(228) ≤ 15.600801734812: improved packing (registration request)
